areas: export, speech, and the iPhone's screens

fixes.key: %@ has its default, %@
fixes.english: %1$@ has its default, %2$@
fixes.before: %1$@ 已使用其默认键 %2$@
fixes.after: %1$@ 已占用此操作的默认键 %2$@
fixes.why: meaning: 其 read as the new holder’s own default; the key is the default of this row’s action, now held by the other action

fixes.key: %@ sound
fixes.english: %@ sound
fixes.before: %@ 声音
fixes.after: “%@”的声音
fixes.why: meaning: with an event such as 播放, 播放 声音 reads as the command “play a sound”

fixes.key: %@ tries again, %@ quits without saving, %@ keeps TextMouth open.
fixes.english: %1$@ tries again, %2$@ quits without saving, %3$@ keeps TextMouth open.
fixes.before: %1$@ 重试，%2$@ 不存储并退出，%3$@ 保持 TextMouth 打开。
fixes.after: “%1$@”会再次尝试存储，“%2$@”会退出且不存储，“%3$@”会让 TextMouth 保持打开。
fixes.why: grammar: with the button names as bare subjects it read 重试 重试; quoted names with 会 make each clause read

fixes.key: %@ uses it in the menus
fixes.english: %@ uses it in the menus
fixes.before: %@ 已在菜单中使用
fixes.after: 菜单命令“%@”已使用此键
fixes.why: meaning: said the command is used in the menus; it is the command that uses the key

fixes.key: %@ was not added back: no copy of the text its package held could be kept first, so TextMouth left the text as it was.
fixes.english: %@ was not added back: no copy of the text its package held could be kept first, so TextMouth left the text as it was.
fixes.before: %@ 未添加回来：无法先保留其包内的文本副本，因此 TextMouth 保持文本不变。
fixes.after: %@ 未重新添加到资料库：无法先保留其包内文本的副本，因此 TextMouth 未改动文本。
fixes.why: natural: 添加回来 is a colloquial word-for-word “added back”

fixes.key: %lld words per minute
fixes.why: term: the speed is 每分钟 %lld 字 everywhere else in the reader; 个词 was the only exception

fixes.key: Adds the speed they count at, such as 2.0x for an audiobook not at 1x, or 500 words a minute for a text book, in the reader, Where Am I?, Copy Reading Position, and the Headings sheet's durations.
fixes.english: Adds the speed they count at, such as 2.0x for an audiobook not at 1x, or 500 words a minute for a text book, in the reader, Where Am I?, Copy Reading Position, and the Headings sheet's durations.
fixes.before: 添加计数所依据的速度，例如不是 1 倍速的有声书的 2.0x，或文本图书的每分钟 500 字，用于阅读器、“我在哪里”、拷贝阅读位置以及章节标题表单的时长。
fixes.after: 注明时间所依据的速度（例如非 1 倍速的有声书为 2.0x，文本图书为每分钟 500 字），用于阅读器、“我在哪里”、“拷贝阅读位置”和章节标题表单中的时长。
fixes.why: natural: 计数 (counting) misread “the speed they count at”, and the examples copied English order; command name quoted

fixes.key: Afterwards, Play tries the passage again
fixes.english: Afterwards, Play tries the passage again
fixes.before: 之后，“播放”会再次尝试该段落。
fixes.after: 之后，“播放”会再次尝试朗读该段落。
fixes.why: natural: 尝试该段落 (try the passage) leaves out what is tried; 尝试朗读

fixes.key: Artist
fixes.english: Artist
fixes.before: 艺术家
fixes.after: 艺人
fixes.why: term: Apple’s Music app calls a track’s artist 艺人

fixes.key: Artist or narrator
fixes.english: Artist or narrator
fixes.before: 艺术家或讲述者
fixes.after: 艺人或讲述者
fixes.why: term: Apple’s Music app calls a track’s artist 艺人

fixes.key: Changes the speed in steps of %lld words per minute.

english.one: Changes the speed in steps of %lld word per minute.
english.other: Changes the speed in steps of %lld words per minute.

before.other: 以每分钟 %lld 个词为步进更改速度。

after.other: 以每分钟 %lld 字为步进更改速度。

fixes.why: term: a text book’s speed is 字 everywhere else in the app; 个词 was a second word for it

fixes.key: Choosing makes the shortcut yours; Reset to Default restores where it works by default.
fixes.english: Choosing makes the shortcut yours; Reset to Default restores where it works by default.
fixes.before: 选取后该快捷键即归你所有；“重置为默认设置”会恢复其默认适用范围。
fixes.after: 选取后，此快捷键即成为你的自定设置；“重置为默认设置”会恢复其默认适用范围。
fixes.why: natural: 归你所有 (becomes your property) is a literal “yours”; choosing makes it a custom setting

fixes.key: Could not save metadata to the library's copy of “%@”, because that file is missing from the library.
fixes.english: Could not save metadata to the library's copy of “%@”, because that file is missing from the library.
fixes.before: 无法将元数据存储到资料库中“%@”的副本，因为该文件已从资料库中缺失。
fixes.after: 无法将元数据存储到资料库中“%@”的副本，因为资料库中已没有该文件。
fixes.why: natural: 已从资料库中缺失 is a literal “is missing from the library”

fixes.key: Decrease speed by %lld words per minute

english.one: Decrease speed by %lld word per minute
english.other: Decrease speed by %lld words per minute

before.other: 将速度降低每分钟 %lld 个词

after.other: 将速度降低每分钟 %lld 字

fixes.why: term: a text book’s speed is 每分钟 %lld 字 everywhere else in the app; 个词 was a second word for it, and this spoken label takes no 字/分钟, whose slash VoiceOver may read aloud

fixes.key: Each heading's title and start, as Audacity labels, for a book with one audio file.
fixes.english: Each heading's title and start, as Audacity labels, for a book with one audio file.
fixes.before: 每个章节标题的标题和起点，存为 Audacity 标签，适用于只有一个音频文件的图书。
fixes.after: 每个章节标题的文字和起点，存为 Audacity 标签，适用于只有一个音频文件的图书。
fixes.why: natural: 章节标题的标题 (the heading’s title) repeats itself; a heading’s 文字

fixes.key: Each heading's title and start, as a CUE sheet naming the audio as Audio exports it.
fixes.english: Each heading's title and start, as a CUE sheet naming the audio as Audio exports it.
fixes.before: 每个章节标题的标题和起点，存为 CUE 表，按“音频”导出的方式命名音频。
fixes.after: 每个章节标题的文字和起点，存为 CUE 表，按“音频”导出的方式命名音频。
fixes.why: natural: 章节标题的标题 (the heading’s title) repeats itself; a heading’s 文字

fixes.key: Each line beginning with <!-- chapter: starts a chapter; keep those lines.
fixes.english: Each line beginning with <!-- chapter: starts a chapter; keep those lines.
fixes.before: 每行以 <!-- chapter: 开头的内容开始一个章节；请保留这些行。
fixes.after: 每个以 <!-- chapter: 开头的行标示一个章节的开始；请保留这些行。
fixes.why: natural: 每行以…开头的内容开始一个章节 garbled the subject; now parallel to the page-marker line

fixes.key: End of the reading list
fixes.english: End of the reading list
fixes.before: 阅读列表结尾
fixes.after: 已到阅读列表结尾
fixes.why: natural: a bare noun phrase in an announcement; 已到…结尾 as the reader’s End of the book. says

fixes.key: Exporting %lld of %@…
fixes.english: Exporting %1$lld of %2$@…
fixes.before: 正在导出 %1$lld，共 %2$@…
fixes.after: 正在导出第 %1$lld 个，共 %2$@…
fixes.why: natural: 正在导出 3，共 40 个项目 left the number without 第…个

fixes.key: How soon a second press must follow the first. A key with different single and double press actions waits this long before its single press acts.
fixes.english: How soon a second press must follow the first. A key with different single and double press actions waits this long before its single press acts.
fixes.before: 第二次按键必须在多久内跟上第一次。单按和连按有不同操作的键，会等待这么久后才执行单按的操作。
fixes.after: 两次按键之间允许的最长间隔。单按和连按操作不同的键，会等待这段时间后再执行单按操作。
fixes.why: natural: 跟上第一次 and 这么久 are a colloquial word-for-word copy of the English

fixes.key: ISO 8859-13 (Baltic)
fixes.english: ISO 8859-13 (Baltic)
fixes.before: ISO 8859-13（波罗的海语）
fixes.after: ISO 8859-13（波罗的海）
fixes.why: natural: 西欧语, 中欧语, and 波罗的海语 name no language; the encoding is named by its region, as CP850（西欧 DOS） is

fixes.key: ISO 8859-15 (Western European)
fixes.english: ISO 8859-15 (Western European)
fixes.before: ISO 8859-15（西欧语）
fixes.why: natural: 西欧语, 中欧语, and 波罗的海语 name no language; the encoding is named by its region, as CP850（西欧 DOS） is

fixes.key: ISO 8859-2 (Central European)
fixes.english: ISO 8859-2 (Central European)
fixes.before: ISO 8859-2（中欧语）
fixes.why: natural: 西欧语, 中欧语, and 波罗的海语 name no language; the encoding is named by its region, as CP850（西欧 DOS） is

fixes.key: Increase speed by %lld words per minute

english.one: Increase speed by %lld word per minute
english.other: Increase speed by %lld words per minute

before.other: 将速度提高每分钟 %lld 个词

after.other: 将速度提高每分钟 %lld 字

fixes.why: term: a text book’s speed is 每分钟 %lld 字 everywhere else in the app; 个词 was a second word for it, and this spoken label takes no 字/分钟, whose slash VoiceOver may read aloud

fixes.key: Its only page is %@.
fixes.english: Its only page is %@.
fixes.before: 唯一的页是 %@。
fixes.after: 此图书仅有一页：%@。
fixes.why: natural: 唯一的页是 is a literal copy of “its only page is”

fixes.key: Jumped to page %@, the %@ page labelled %@.
fixes.english: Jumped to page %1$@, the %2$@ page labelled %3$@.
fixes.before: 已跳转到页 %1$@，即标注为 %3$@ 的页面中的%2$@个。
fixes.after: 已跳转到第 %1$@ 页，即标注为 %3$@ 的%2$@个页面。
fixes.why: natural: 页 %1$@ copied the English order; %2$@ is an ordinal such as 第二, so it goes before 个页面

fixes.key: Jumped to page %@.
fixes.english: Jumped to page %@.
fixes.before: 已跳转到页 %@。
fixes.after: 已跳转到第 %@ 页。
fixes.why: natural: 页 %@ copied the English order; 第 %@ 页 as elsewhere in the reader

fixes.key: Keeps the list's books downloaded on this Mac; each Mac chooses for itself. Clearing it removes no download.
fixes.english: Keeps the list's books downloaded on this Mac; each Mac chooses for itself. Clearing it removes no download.
fixes.before: 将列表中的图书保留下载在这台 Mac 上；每台 Mac 各自选择。取消勾选不会移除已有的下载。
fixes.after: 让列表中的图书在这台 Mac 上保持下载状态；每台 Mac 各自选择。取消勾选不会移除已有的下载。
fixes.why: natural: 保留下载在这台 Mac 上 is an ungrammatical copy of “keeps downloaded on”

fixes.key: Mac Central European
fixes.english: Mac Central European

fixes.after: Mac 中欧
fixes.why: natural: 西欧语, 中欧语, and 波罗的海语 name no language; the encoding is named by its region, as CP850（西欧 DOS） is

fixes.key: Mac Roman (Western European)
fixes.english: Mac Roman (Western European)
fixes.before: Mac Roman（西欧语）
fixes.after: Mac Roman（西欧）
fixes.why: natural: 西欧语, 中欧语, and 波罗的海语 name no language; the encoding is named by its region, as CP850（西欧 DOS） is

fixes.key: Metadata saved to the library's copy of “%@”.
fixes.english: Metadata saved to the library's copy of “%@”.
fixes.before: 元数据已存储到资料库及资料库中“%@”的副本。
fixes.after: 元数据已存储到资料库中“%@”的副本。
fixes.why: natural: 资料库及资料库中 repeated the library and added what the English does not say

fixes.key: Preview %@ sound
fixes.english: Preview %@ sound
fixes.before: 试听 %@ 声音
fixes.after: 试听“%@”的声音
fixes.why: meaning: with an event such as 播放, 试听 播放 声音 reads as a run of commands; the sound of that event

fixes.key: Quitting now leaves these changes unsaved:
fixes.english: Quitting now leaves these changes unsaved:
fixes.before: 现在退出会使这些更改不被存储：
fixes.after: 现在退出将不会存储以下更改：
fixes.why: natural: 会使这些更改不被存储 is a stiff causative copy of “leaves these changes unsaved”

fixes.key: Rich text, with each heading at its outline level, for Word, Pages, and TextEdit.
fixes.english: Rich text, with each heading at its outline level, for Word, Pages, and TextEdit.
fixes.before: 富文本，每个章节标题按其大纲级别保留，适用于 Word、Pages 和“文本编辑”。
fixes.after: 富文本，每个章节标题按其大纲级别保留，适用于 Word、Pages 文稿和“文本编辑”。
fixes.why: term: Apple’s Chinese name of Pages is Pages 文稿, as TextEdit is 文本编辑

fixes.key: Section included: %@
fixes.english: Section included: %@
fixes.before: 已包含章节：%@
fixes.after: 已包含此部分：%@
fixes.why: term: 章节 is the glossary’s Chapter; a heading’s section is 部分, as the Skip Section and Include Section commands say

fixes.key: Section skipped: %@
fixes.english: Section skipped: %@
fixes.before: 已略过章节：%@
fixes.after: 已跳过此部分：%@
fixes.why: term: 章节 is the glossary’s Chapter; a heading’s section is 部分, as the Skip Section and Include Section commands say

fixes.key: Shows the page being read, such as Page 12 of 300, beside the percent, for books of more than one page.
fixes.english: Shows the page being read, such as Page 12 of 300, beside the percent, for books of more than one page.
fixes.before: 在百分比旁显示正在阅读的页，如第 12 页，共 300 页，适用于多页图书。
fixes.after: 在百分比旁显示正在阅读的页码（如第 12 页，共 300 页），适用于多页图书。
fixes.why: natural: the example ran into the sentence between commas; parentheses as in the Where Am I? page setting

fixes.key: Sleep timer expired
fixes.english: Sleep timer expired
fixes.before: 睡眠定时器已到时
fixes.after: 睡眠定时器已结束
fixes.why: natural: 已到时 is not how Chinese says a timer ran out (到时 reads as “when the time comes”); 已结束

fixes.key: Sleep timer expired at the end of the heading. Playback paused.
fixes.english: Sleep timer expired at the end of the heading. Playback paused.
fixes.before: 睡眠定时器已在章节标题结尾到时。播放已暂停。
fixes.after: 睡眠定时器已在章节标题结尾处结束。播放已暂停。
fixes.why: natural: 已到时 is not how Chinese says a timer ran out (到时 reads as “when the time comes”); 已结束

fixes.key: Sleep timer expired. Playback paused.
fixes.english: Sleep timer expired. Playback paused.
fixes.before: 睡眠定时器已到时。播放已暂停。
fixes.after: 睡眠定时器已结束。播放已暂停。
fixes.why: natural: 已到时 is not how Chinese says a timer ran out (到时 reads as “when the time comes”); 已结束

english.one: Speed: %lld word per minute; rate %@, pitch %@, volume %@
english.other: Speed: %lld words per minute; rate %@, pitch %@, volume %@

before.other: 速度：每分钟 %lld 个词；速率 %@，音调 %@，音量 %@

after.other: 速度：每分钟 %lld 字；速率 %@，音调 %@，音量 %@

fixes.key: Start of the book.
fixes.english: Start of the book.
fixes.before: 图书开头。
fixes.after: 已到图书开头。
fixes.why: natural: a bare noun phrase in an announcement; 已到…, as the reader’s End of the book. says

fixes.key: Start of the reading list
fixes.english: Start of the reading list
fixes.before: 阅读列表开头
fixes.after: 已到阅读列表开头
fixes.why: natural: a bare noun phrase in an announcement; 已到…, as the reader’s End of the book. says

fixes.key: Starting: %@
fixes.english: Starting: %@
fixes.before: 正在开始：%@
fixes.after: 开始播放：%@
fixes.why: natural: 正在开始 (is starting) names no action; the next book starts playing

fixes.key: Still starting: %@
fixes.english: Still starting: %@
fixes.before: 仍在开始：%@
fixes.after: 仍在打开：%@

fixes.key: Text not updated: %@ was removed, or its download deleted, so Edit Text has stopped for it.
fixes.english: Text not updated: %@ was removed, or its download deleted, so Edit Text has stopped for it.
fixes.before: 文本未更新：%@ 已被移除或其下载已删除，因此“编辑文本”已为其停止。
fixes.after: 文本未更新：%@ 已被移除或其下载已删除，因此其“编辑文本”已停止。
fixes.why: natural: 已为其停止 is a literal “has stopped for it”; worded as the other Edit Text stopped messages

fixes.key: Text not updated: the edited transcript of %@ has %@, but the audiobook has %@. Keep every line beginning with <!-- chapter: and save again; the book keeps its old text until then.
fixes.english: Text not updated: the edited transcript of %1$@ has %2$@, but the audiobook has %3$@. Keep every line beginning with <!-- chapter: and save again; the book keeps its old text until then.
fixes.before: 文本未更新：%1$@ 编辑后的文字稿有 %2$@，而有声书有 %3$@。请保留每一行以 <!-- chapter: 开头的行，然后再次存储；在此之前，图书保留其旧文本。
fixes.after: 文本未更新：%1$@ 编辑后的文字稿有 %2$@，而有声书有 %3$@。请保留每个以 <!-- chapter: 开头的行，然后再次存储；在此之前，图书保留其旧文本。
fixes.why: grammar: 保留每一行以…开头的行 repeated 行 and garbled the object

fixes.key: TextMouth is finishing up before it quits: %@. It quits when that is done.
fixes.english: TextMouth is finishing up before it quits: %@. It quits when that is done.
fixes.before: TextMouth 正在完成收尾工作后退出：%@。完成后会自动退出。
fixes.after: TextMouth 正在完成退出前的收尾工作：%@。完成后即会退出。
fixes.why: grammar: 正在完成收尾工作后退出 said it finishes up after quitting

fixes.key: TextMouth reads BRF and BRL files you add from now on with these characters, and recognizes Unicode braille patterns by itself. The Export dialog starts a BRF with them. A book keeps its import characters, which Book Information can change.
fixes.english: TextMouth reads BRF and BRL files you add from now on with these characters, and recognizes Unicode braille patterns by itself. The Export dialog starts a BRF with them. A book keeps its import characters, which Book Information can change.
fixes.before: TextMouth 对此后添加的 BRF 和 BRL 文件使用这些字符读取，并自动识别 Unicode 盲文点型。“导出”对话框用它们开始写 BRF。每本图书保留其导入时的字符，可在“图书信息”中更改。
fixes.after: TextMouth 会用这些字符读取此后添加的 BRF 和 BRL 文件，并自动识别 Unicode 盲文点型。“导出”对话框导出 BRF 时默认使用这些字符。每本图书保留其导入时的字符，可在“图书信息”中更改。
fixes.why: meaning: 用它们开始写 BRF (begins writing a BRF with them) misread “starts a BRF with them”, the dialog’s default

fixes.key: The %@ page labelled %@
fixes.english: The %1$@ page labelled %2$@
fixes.after: 标注为 %2$@ 的%1$@个页面
fixes.why: meaning: 第二页 reads as page 2; 第二个页面 is the second of the pages with that label

fixes.key: The audio file %@ ends before its audio does, so it could not be converted.
fixes.english: The audio file %@ ends before its audio does, so it could not be converted.
fixes.before: 音频文件 %@ 在音频播完之前就结束了，因此无法转换。
fixes.after: 音频文件 %@ 在其音频结束之前就已截断，因此无法转换。
fixes.why: meaning: 在音频播完之前 (before the audio finished playing) misread a file that is cut short

fixes.key: The file %@ could not be read quickly enough.
fixes.english: The file %@ could not be read quickly enough.
fixes.before: 无法足够快地读取文件 %@。
fixes.after: 文件 %@ 读取速度过慢。
fixes.why: natural: 无法足够快地读取 is a word-for-word “could not be read quickly enough”

fixes.key: The heading whose section ends the audio, with its subheadings, or the end of the book.
fixes.english: The heading whose section ends the audio, with its subheadings, or the end of the book.
fixes.before: 其章节标题所属部分结束于音频末尾的章节标题（含其子标题），或图书结尾。
fixes.after: 音频结束的位置：某个章节标题所属部分（含其子标题）的末尾，或图书结尾。
fixes.why: natural: the hint wound the heading around its own section; now parallel to the From hint (音频开始的位置：…)

fixes.key: The reading list is empty. To add a book, choose Add to Reading List from its context menu, its VoiceOver actions, or the Library menu.
fixes.english: The reading list is empty. To add a book, choose Add to Reading List from its context menu, its VoiceOver actions, or the Library menu.
fixes.before: 阅读列表为空。要添加图书，请从其上下文菜单、VoiceOver 操作或“资料库”菜单中选取“添加到阅读列表”。
fixes.after: 阅读列表为空。要添加图书，请从其快捷菜单、VoiceOver 操作或“资料库”菜单中选取“添加到阅读列表”。
fixes.why: term: Apple’s Chinese calls a context menu 快捷菜单

fixes.key: The recording as it was made, before any edits.
fixes.english: The recording as it was made, before any edits.
fixes.before: 录音的原始状态，编辑之前。
fixes.after: 录音制作时的原样，未经任何编辑。
fixes.why: natural: the trailing 编辑之前 dangled after the noun phrase

fixes.key: This Kindle book is copy-protected, and TextMouth can't read copy-protected books.
fixes.english: This Kindle book is copy-protected, and TextMouth can't read copy-protected books.
fixes.before: 此 Kindle 图书受版权保护，TextMouth 无法读取受版权保护的图书。
fixes.after: 此 Kindle 图书受拷贝保护，TextMouth 无法读取受拷贝保护的图书。
fixes.why: meaning: 受版权保护 means under copyright, as nearly every book is; this is copy protection (DRM), as the Audible message says

fixes.key: This book has no pages.
fixes.english: This book has no pages.
fixes.before: 此图书没有页。
fixes.after: 此图书没有页码。
fixes.why: natural: 没有页 is not idiomatic; a book without page marks has no 页码

fixes.key: This book's only page is %@.
fixes.english: This book's only page is %@.
fixes.before: 此图书唯一的页是 %@。
fixes.after: 此图书仅有一页：%@。
fixes.why: natural: 唯一的页是 is a literal copy of “only page is”

fixes.key: This file is not a web archive TextMouth can read. It may be damaged, or another kind of file.
fixes.english: This file is not a web archive TextMouth can read. It may be damaged, or another kind of file.
fixes.before: 此文件不是 TextMouth 可读取的网页档案。它可能已损坏，或是其他类型的文件。
fixes.after: 此文件不是 TextMouth 可读取的网页归档。它可能已损坏，或是其他类型的文件。
fixes.why: term: Safari calls a .webarchive 网页归档

fixes.key: This web archive holds a file of the type “%@”, not a web page or text, so it has nothing to read.
fixes.english: This web archive holds a file of the type “%@”, not a web page or text, so it has nothing to read.
fixes.before: 此网页档案中的文件类型为“%@”，不是网页或文本，因此没有可读取的内容。
fixes.after: 此网页归档中的文件类型为“%@”，不是网页或文本，因此没有可读取的内容。
fixes.why: term: Safari calls a .webarchive 网页归档

fixes.key: Two presses, %@ apart. Set the time above %@ to count them as one.
fixes.english: Two presses, %1$@ apart. Set the time above %2$@ to count them as one.
fixes.before: 两次按键相隔 %1$@。请将时间设置为高于 %2$@，才会将它们算作一次。
fixes.after: 两次按键相隔 %1$@。若要将它们算作连按两次，请将时间设为高于 %2$@。
fixes.why: meaning: 算作一次 (count as one time) reads as a single press; they would count as a double press

fixes.key: Voice language filter
fixes.english: Voice language filter
fixes.before: 语音语言过滤器
fixes.after: 按语言筛选语音
fixes.why: natural: 过滤器 is a filter device; a menu that narrows a list is 筛选

fixes.key: Whether each page's last line carries its braille page number.
fixes.english: Whether each page's last line carries its braille page number.
fixes.before: 每页最后一行是否带有该盲文页码。
fixes.after: 每页最后一行是否带有其盲文页码。
fixes.why: natural: 该盲文页码 (that braille page number) points at nothing; the page’s own number is 其

fixes.key: Windows-1250 (Central European)
fixes.english: Windows-1250 (Central European)
fixes.before: Windows-1250（中欧语）
fixes.after: Windows-1250（中欧）
fixes.why: natural: 西欧语, 中欧语, and 波罗的海语 name no language; the encoding is named by its region, as CP850（西欧 DOS） is

fixes.key: Windows-1252 (Western European)
fixes.english: Windows-1252 (Western European)
fixes.before: Windows-1252（西欧语）
fixes.after: Windows-1252（西欧）
fixes.why: natural: 西欧语, 中欧语, and 波罗的海语 name no language; the encoding is named by its region, as CP850（西欧 DOS） is

fixes.key: Windows-1257 (Baltic)
fixes.english: Windows-1257 (Baltic)
fixes.before: Windows-1257（波罗的海语）
fixes.after: Windows-1257（波罗的海）
fixes.why: natural: 西欧语, 中欧语, and 波罗的海语 name no language; the encoding is named by its region, as CP850（西欧 DOS） is

fixes.key: it has %@, where the audiobook has %@. Keep every line beginning with <!-- chapter: and save again, and the text shows.
fixes.english: it has %1$@, where the audiobook has %2$@. Keep every line beginning with <!-- chapter: and save again, and the text shows.
fixes.before: 它有 %1$@，而有声书有 %2$@。请保留每一行以 <!-- chapter: 开头的行，然后再次存储，文本便会显示。
fixes.after: 它有 %1$@，而有声书有 %2$@。请保留每个以 <!-- chapter: 开头的行，然后再次存储，文本便会显示。
fixes.why: grammar: 保留每一行以…开头的行 repeated 行 and garbled the object

fixes.key: on the %@ page labelled %@
fixes.english: on the %1$@ page labelled %2$@
fixes.before: 位于标注为 %2$@ 的%1$@页
fixes.after: 位于标注为 %2$@ 的%1$@个页面
fixes.why: meaning: 第二页 reads as page 2; 第二个页面 is the second of the pages with that label

fixes.key: the file %@ could not be read quickly enough
fixes.english: the file %@ could not be read quickly enough
fixes.before: 无法足够快地读取文件 %@
fixes.after: 文件 %@ 读取速度过慢
fixes.why: natural: 无法足够快地读取 is a word-for-word “could not be read quickly enough”
